usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-tight, font-bold (700) or extra-bold (800). Use for page titles and major stats.
usage_rules.body: Clean, legible, tracking-normal. Use for general text and labels.
usage_rules.mono: Use for ALL numbers, dates, timers, and data values. This creates the 'dashboard' feel.

semantic_usage.success: #22c55e (Green-500) - Use for streaks, completed habits, growth.
semantic_usage.focus: #3b82f6 (Blue-500) - Use for study timers, academic metrics.

layout.spacing_system: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside containers. Tight gaps (gap-2, gap-4) between data points.
layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Dashboard). Mobile-first single column that expands to 3-column on desktop.
layout.container_style: Grid Borders. Avoid shadows. Use 1px borders with zinc-800 color to define areas.
layout.mobile_navigation: Fixed bottom navigation bar with 4-5 key icons (Home, Log, Groups, Leaderboard, Profile).
layout.border_radius: rounded-md (6px) or rounded-sm (4px). Avoid fully rounded 'pill' shapes unless it's a status badge.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast.
buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide

cards.style: Flat, dark background (zinc-900/50), 1px border (zinc-800). No shadow.

inputs.style: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent font-mono

charts.style: Minimalist. Hide grid lines if possible. Use tooltips for data. Colors must match semantic palette.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use for 'Streak' visualization or active timer progress.
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Optional subtle overlay for 'hacker/builder' vibe in specific sections.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use ONLY for the bottom navigation bar (backdrop-blur-lg bg-black/80 border-t border-white/10).

motion.micro_interactions: Scale down (0.98) on button press. Brighten border on input focus.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in (opacity-0 to opacity-100) + slight slide-up (translate-y-4 to translate-y-0).

media.image_style: High contrast, desaturated or duotone (Black & Primary Color). Dark overlay (bg-black/60) to ensure text readability.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is WCAG AA compliant. Use zinc-400 for secondary text, white for primary.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible ring-2 ring-primary on all interactive elements.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px height for all mobile buttons.

tech_stack_specifics.icons: Lucide React (default) or Phosphor Icons (recommended for 'bold' weight)

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Implement the 'Dark Mode' class in tailwind.config.js and ensure 'dark' class is applied to the root HTML element by default.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Install the Google Fonts (Barlow Condensed, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) in public/index.html.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Create a 'Layout' component that handles the mobile bottom navigation and top header.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Use the 'Bento Grid' pattern for the main dashboard. It should look like a tactical HUD.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: For the 'Performance Index', use a circular progress indicator or a radar chart.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Ensure all forms (Login, Logging) are validated and have clear error states.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Mock the backend calls if the API is not ready, but structure the data to match the expected MongoDB schema.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: CRITICAL: Use .js/.jsx extensions. Do not use TypeScript syntax.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids and asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
